title: 审批平台 · 引擎任务
description: Flowable 引擎任务数量和死信告警。数量为顺序查询，不相加作为原子总数；监控不可用不是业务恢复。

panels.title: 服务状态
panels.description: 仅显示选中且明确启用引擎任务监控的目标；没有匹配目标时为未知。

panels.title: 完整采样
panels.description: 使用实际引擎任务规则中的完整采样记录；缺失或无效的数据不补零。

panels.title: 可执行任务
panels.description: 包含等待执行及已被锁定的任务，不等于立即可执行的精确积压。

targets.expr: (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="executable"} >= 0) and (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="executable"} < +Inf) and ignoring (queue) ((approval:engine_job_sample_healthy{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1) and on (job, instance, environment) (up{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1))

panels.title: 定时任务
panels.description: 包含未来定时任务及重试计划；计划中的定时任务不自动视为故障。

targets.expr: (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="timer"} >= 0) and (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="timer"} < +Inf) and ignoring (queue) ((approval:engine_job_sample_healthy{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1) and on (job, instance, environment) (up{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1))

panels.title: 暂停任务
panels.description: 暂停属于状态信息；不自动视为失败，也不触发恢复操作。

targets.expr: (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="suspended"} >= 0) and (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="suspended"} < +Inf) and ignoring (queue) ((approval:engine_job_sample_healthy{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1) and on (job, instance, environment) (up{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1))

panels.title: 死信任务
panels.description: 死信任务不等于整个审批流程终态失败；看板不提供自动重试或删除。

targets.expr: (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="dead_letter"} >= 0) and (approval_engine_jobs{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled",queue="dead_letter"} < +Inf) and ignoring (queue) ((approval:engine_job_sample_healthy{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1) and on (job, instance, environment) (up{job="approval-platform",environment=~"${environment:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",engine_job_monitor="enabled"} == 1))
